item.title: US stocks erase sharp losses, while oil prices leap on worries about Iran war
item.description: Oil prices leaped Monday on worries that war with Iran could clog the global flow of crude and make inflation even worse. U.S. stocks, meanwhile, swung from sharp losses to a tiny gain.

item.title: No suspects identified in deadly double shooting in east Houston, HPD says
item.description: Police said the woman was found in a ditch, while the man was found in the middle of the road, both with multiple gunshot wounds. Two days into the case, and police are still searching for answers.

item.title: Video shows Waymo robo-taxi stopped in the road blocking first responders in Austin
item.description: Days after an autonomous vehicle service started in Houston, Austin first responders took questions about images showing a driverless car blocking personnel near a mass shooting situation.

item.title: City of Houston offering loans for those who redevelop possibly contaminated properties
item.description: The City of Houston is looking to give away federal grant money to local governments and organizations to clean up and revitalize properties that have been possibly contaminated.

item.title: Live's 'After the Oscars Show' Countdown begins on Hollywood's biggest morning
item.description: Emmy Award-Winning Hosts Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos will host "Live with Kelly and Mark' at the Famed Dolby Theatre the morning after the Oscars.

item.title: 4 people injured in truck fire at scrap yard in Second Ward, according to Houston Fire Department
item.description: The Houston Fire Department said it is unclear what sparked the flame in a truck fire that injured four people in Houston's Second Ward.

item.title: Rain chances are back but don't really blossom until this weekend
item.description: It's another warm, humid week but this time we've got some decent rain chances coming our way.

item.title: 4 injured after repeat DWI driver crashes into crowded sidewalk in Spring Branch area, police say
item.description: A Saturday night in the Spring Branch area turned violent when police say an intoxicated driver plowed into a crowded sidewalk near a neighborhood park, leaving four people with serious injuries.

item.title: Apartment intruder reaches second-floor balcony without ladder, pulls gun on teen resident: Pct. 4
item.description: An 18-year-old north Harris County man says he had a gun pulled on him after confronting a man who scaled his apartment building and made it to his second-floor balcony.

item.title: Children's and Family Emmy Awards held in NYC; Disney shatters record for most nominations
item.description: The Walt Disney Company shattered the record for most nominations, receiving 102.
